Send all cards in the dungeon to the GYs, except the trapped monster. Your opponent Dimensions from their dice pool, OR Resurrects from their GY, one monster. Players cannot place any other cards in the dungeon. DMs cannot lose their last life. Play until only 1 monster remains in the dungeon. Its controller wins. If none remain: You lose.

cards.name: Dice Re-Roll
cards.effect: Req: You just rolled for turn. Ignore the results of the roll, and roll again.

cards.name: Melffy Staring Contest
cards.effect: Target 1 Beast you control and 1 of your opponent's monsters in line. Once per game, if one of them moves in a direction other than towards the other monster, it takes damage equal to the other monster's ATK.

cards.name: Fairy Archer
cards.effect: Reach, Range 3

cards.name: Infernity Archer
cards.effect: This monster can attack any monster in line.

cards.name: Call of the Mummy
cards.effect: Before your roll: This turn, you can give your Zombies Starsurge 1, and if you dimension a Zombie, that monster's Dungeon Piece must touch this card's Dungeon Piece.

cards.name: Reinforcement of the Army's Troops
cards.effect: Before your roll: This turn, you can give your Warriors Starsurge 1, and if you dimension a Warrior, that monster's Dungeon Piece must touch this card's Dungeon Piece.

cards.name: Draconic Tactics
cards.effect: Before your roll: This turn, you can give your Dragons Starsurge 1, and if you dimension a Dragon, that monster's Dungeon Piece must touch this card's Dungeon Piece.

cards.name: Cattle Call
cards.effect: Before your roll: This turn, you can give your Beasts Starsurge 1, and if you dimension a Beast, that monster's Dungeon Piece must touch this card's Dungeon Piece.

cards.name: Magician's Circle
cards.effect: Before your roll: This turn, you can give your Spellcasters Starsurge 1, and if you dimension a Spellcaster, that monster's Dungeon Piece must touch this card's Dungeon Piece.

cards.name: Thunder Ball
cards.effect: Spell ×3 Once per turn: Advance in a straight line. If a card stopped this monster, destroy it.

cards.name: Spatial Collapse
cards.effect: During each End of Turn, block the outmost unblocked lines of the dungeon. Both DMs get pushed forward 1 tile. Each card that occupies a blocked tile advances inward 1 tile. If it can't, it is destroyed.

cards.name: Worm Drake
cards.effect: Monsters that battled this monster are Immobilized, and cannot attack, as long as this monster is within 1 tile.

cards.name: Castle Gate
cards.effect:
Immobilized
All tiles in a horizontal line are blocked.
Your monsters can move through this monster.

cards.name: Marauding Captain
cards.effect:
Swift 2
Each of your Warriors behind Marauding Captain has Swift 2.

cards.name: Darkbishop Archfiend
cards.effect: This monster can move diagonally by paying 2 Movement.

cards.name: Destruction God - Lani
cards.effect: Gains 10 ATK for each Zombie in your GY. If one of your Zombies, or an opponent's monster, moves, and gets within 5 spaces of this monster at any time, you can move this monster the same number of spaces, for free.

cards.name: Man-Eater Bug
cards.effect: Dimension: You can destroy 1 monster within 2 squares.

cards.name: Mimicking Man-Eater Bug
cards.effect: Dimension: You can destroy a monster within 5 squares. This monster gains ATK equal to the destroyed monster's ATK, and become that monster's type. Unaffected by the effects of monsters of the same type.

cards.name: Nobleman-Eater Bug
cards.effect: Dimension: You can destroy up to 2 monsters within 3 squares.

cards.name: Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
cards.effect:
Flying
If you rolled a summon crest of this monster: You can tribute 1 Dragon; This monster gains Beacon.
Spell ×? Once per game: Resurrect 1 Dragon (? = Dragon's Level × 3)

cards.name: Tiras, Keeper of Armageddon
cards.effect:
Indestructible by effects
After this monster battles: You can destroy a card within 5 squares. At the end of your turn, this monster looses 20 DEF.

cards.name: Winged Dragon 1
cards.effect:
Flying
Prevent all Tunneling. If you also have "Winged Dragon #2" in the dungeon: Creatures with Tunneling have Sluggish 2.

cards.name: Dark-Eyes Illusionist
cards.effect:
Trap ×4 When a monster is targeted for an attack or an effect: Negate it.
Spell ×4 Select a monster type. All monsters become that monster type until end of turn.

cards.name: Super-Electromagnetic Voltech Dragon
cards.effect:
Dimension: Your opponent monsters within 5 tiles must move toward, and attack, this monster, doing as much as possible. Nearest monsters move first.
Adjacent opponent monsters are Immobilized.

cards.name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
cards.effect:
Flying
Spell ×5 Tribute this monster: Warp 1 opponent monster to this monster's tile, and gain control of it.

cards.name: Tyrant Dragon
cards.effect:
Flying
Spell ×3 Ignore this monster's Flying movement restriction.
Attack ×2 If this monster attacks: Set the defending monster's DEF to 0.

cards.name: Dark Necrofear
cards.effect: Trap ×3 If this monster is destroyed: Gain control of 1 opponent monster.

cards.name: Jinzo
cards.effect: Spell ×5 Set your opponent's Trap crest count to 0.

cards.name: Spell Canceller
cards.effect: Spell ×5 Set your opponent's Spell crest count to 0.

cards.name: Trap Bandit
cards.effect: Set your Trap crest count to 0.
